preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and the restriction k must satisfy the bounds specified.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] < i + 2 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The parent array must have n-1 elements and each parent must be a valid vertex index.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of different leaves visited as a string.
